theorems.name: Submission.pcoarea_flat_jacobian_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (A : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) (Γ : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn m) (T : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)) (E : Rn k →ₗ[ℝ] Rn (m + k)), Function.Bijective T → (∀ v, (T v).fst = Γ v) → (∀ z, T (E z) = WithLp.toLp 2 (0, z)) → (A ∘ₗ E).normDet * T.normDet = (A ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint Γ).normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
